weight_confirmation.confirmation_mode: adjacent acceptance of the enumerated fixed V1.0 12-factor proposal

fund_flow_partial_source.adapter_semantics: --keep-fund-flow preserves the listed historical large/medium-order flow fields and converts present fields with pandas.to_numeric; the source help text says they are retained for a later incremental layer.

factors.name: Market Regime
known_components: V3.10 run_panel_backtest.py computes daily market breadth state from active-stock advance/decline counts.
Partial state mapping is HOT when adv_all > 3000, NEUTRAL when adv_all >= 1000, otherwise COLD.
Accepted V1.0 framework uses market regime as a position/risk environment control rather than individual-stock alpha ordering.
missing: Exact full attack/range/defense regime formula and normalization.
Exact index-trend thresholds and volatility/risk-release mapping.
Prior-day limit-up performance input binding.
First-30-minute volume input binding and source bytes.
Exact mapping from full regime state to the 8-percent factor score.

factors.name: Market Breadth/Diffusion
known_components: V3.10 file-backed panel code computes adv_all, dec_all, flat_all, adv_ratio_all and eligible-universe analogues.
The same daily panel component computes median cross-sectional return.
missing: Exact breadth/diffusion factor normalization and clipping.

factors.name: Position
known_components: V3.10 Daily Base computes pos20, pos60 and pos120 as (close - rolling_min) / (rolling_max - rolling_min).
The file-backed Daily Base life/consumption subscores use pos120 thresholds, preserving a real position-state implementation.
missing: Proof that the Daily Base position implementation is identical to the final 12-percent factor definition.
Exact aggregation of 20/60/120 positions in the full strategy.
Final factor normalization/clipping and full-strategy source bytes.

factors.name: Multi-Momentum
known_components: V3.10 Daily Base computes r5, r10, r20, r60 and r120 exact close-to-close returns.
Daily raw_strength awards 20 points for each positive r5/r10/r20/r60/r120.
missing: Proof that Daily raw_strength is the final 10-percent Multi-Momentum factor.
Exact horizon aggregation and normalization in the full 12-factor strategy.
Executable final-strategy source code.

factors.name: Trend Quality
known_components: V3.10 Daily Base has an executable trend_quality subscore using slope20, r2_20, er20 and close_loc.
Recovered thresholds: slope20 > 0 adds 15 otherwise subtracts 10; r2_20 > 0.55 adds 10; er20 > 0.35 adds 10; close_loc > 0.65 adds 10; close_loc < 0.30 subtracts 10; score clips to 0..100.
missing: Proof that this Daily Base subscore is exactly the final 8-percent Trend Quality factor.
Any non-Daily overlays or regime-conditioned normalization.
Executable complete-strategy source code.

factors.name: Efficiency Ratio
known_components: V3.10 Daily Base computes ER10 and ER20 as absolute displacement divided by summed absolute path movement.
The recovered trend_quality subscore explicitly uses ER20 > 0.35 as a positive condition.
missing: Exact ER horizon selection/aggregation for the final 7-percent factor.
Exact normalization/clipping of the factor in the full strategy.
Executable complete-strategy source code.
